stances.meaning: The classification implies nothing that a check could falsify, such as a call that returns nothing.
The claim needs a machinery that the run does not supply.
stances.closes: The param machineries on the declaration, or a runtime that supplies the machinery.

stances.meaning: dokimi could build the check and rules it out because of its cost.
The check would read a part of the declaration that no generator can read.
stances.closes: A change of the vocabulary of the shape catalog.

stances.meaning: The classification implies something that no claim witnesses.
stances.closes: A new claim in the spec.
